name: SpliceAI_predict_splice
description: Predict splice-altering effects using SpliceAI. Returns delta scores for acceptor/donor gain/loss as prediction and route-trigger context. SpliceAI scores are source leads or computational/splicing route triggers only, not ACMG counted evidence by themselves. For germline ACMG/pathogenicity final classification, route prediction or RNA evidence through the appropriate ACMG overlay, emit an acmg_assessment_bundle, and require validator_status: PASS.
acmg_gate_notice: ACMG gate: direct ToolUniverse tools such as GeneBe, InterVar, ClinVar, SpliceAI, MyVariant, Ensembl VEP, gnomAD, MaveDB/DMS, ClinGen/G2P, GeneReviews, and related variant evidence tools provide source leads, coverage hits, route triggers, or annotation inputs only; they are not ACMG counted evidence. Final germline ACMG/pathogenicity output requires ACMG_overlay_gate_assess_variant, an acmg_assessment_bundle, and validator_status: PASS.

variant.description: Variant in chr-pos-ref-alt format (e.g., chr8-140300616-T-G) or colon-separated

distance.description: Distance parameter for model (default: 50). Larger values capture more distal effects.

mask.description: Use masked scores (recommended for variant interpretation). Raw scores better for alternative splicing analysis.

name: SpliceAI_get_max_delta
description: Get a simplified maximum SpliceAI delta score and interpretation for variant triage. The score is a source lead or computational/splicing route trigger only, not ACMG counted evidence by itself. For germline ACMG/pathogenicity final classification, route prediction or RNA evidence through the appropriate ACMG overlay, emit an acmg_assessment_bundle, and require validator_status: PASS.
acmg_gate_notice: ACMG gate: direct ToolUniverse tools such as GeneBe, InterVar, ClinVar, SpliceAI, MyVariant, Ensembl VEP, gnomAD, MaveDB/DMS, ClinGen/G2P, GeneReviews, and related variant evidence tools provide source leads, coverage hits, route triggers, or annotation inputs only; they are not ACMG counted evidence. Final germline ACMG/pathogenicity output requires ACMG_overlay_gate_assess_variant, an acmg_assessment_bundle, and validator_status: PASS.

name: SpliceAI_predict_pangolin
description: Predict splice-altering effects using Pangolin model (alternative to SpliceAI). Pangolin uses a different architecture and may provide complementary predictions. Returns splice effect scores per transcript. Useful for validation or when SpliceAI gives borderline results.
